title: LACS: Distribution-Sensitive Label-Agnostic Confidence Selection for Dynamic Data Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2611.05616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training on large datasets motivates selecting which examples receive expensive training computation. Fixed quotas determine the amount of pruning in advance, while absolute confidence cutoffs depend on the score scale. We study a population-relative alternative that adapts the threshold and retained count together. We introduce LACS (Label-Agnostic Confidence Selector), a training-time rule based on maximum predictive confidence, requiring neither labels at selection time nor per-example gradients. LACS removes examples at or above a log-mean-exp reference plus a margin. We characterize its sensitivity to score gaps and mass, and derive an exact no-pruning condition. For $0<\rho<1$, the removed fraction is at most $\rho$ and at least one example remains. The unsigned score permits both confidently correct and confidently wrong examples to be removed. Seven evaluation settings include neural training, language modeling, and boosting. Neu

translated_title: LACS：用于动态数据剪枝的分布敏感、标签无关的置信度选择
translated_abstract: 在大规模数据集上进行训练促使我们选择哪些样本能够获得昂贵的训练计算资源。固定配额方法会预先确定剪枝的数量，而绝对置信度阈值则依赖于分数的尺度。我们研究了一种基于总体相对性的替代方法，该方法能够同时自适应地调整阈值和保留样本数量。我们提出了LACS（标签无关置信度选择器），这是一种基于最大预测置信度的训练时规则，在选择时既不需要标签，也不需要逐样本的梯度。LACS会移除分数达到或超过log-mean-exp参考值加上一个余量的样本。我们刻画了该方法对分数差距和分布质量的敏感性，并推导出了精确的不剪枝条件。对于0<ρ<1，移除的比例至多为ρ，且至少保留一个样本。由于采用无符号分数，该方法能够同时移除高置信度正确和高置信度错误的样本。评估涵盖七个设置，包括神经网络训练、语言建模和提升方法。
tldr: 提出了LACS，一种基于最大预测置信度、无需标签和逐样本梯度的动态数据剪枝方法，通过分布敏感的方式同时自适应调整阈值与保留样本数量，在七种评估设置中均验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: LACS is a label-agnostic, per-example-gradient-free dynamic data pruning method based on maximum predictive confidence that adaptively adjusts both the threshold and retained count in a distribution-sensitive manner.
